0022600153.text: The Houston Rockets (5-1, 2nd in the West and 0.5 games behind the 1st-place Southwest team) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West) in the Rockets' seventh game of the season, with both teams coming off a loss. Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Rockets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, and they won their last meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
